intro: Ndi umukoze wa porogaramu ugitangira. Nyobora serivisi yo kwakira seriveri ASHIKA Network n'urutonde rwa seriveri za Minecraft SABALISU, kandi nkora porogaramu ya seriveri ya Minecraft Storia.
about: Ndacyari mushya, ariko nandika kode buri munsi kandi ndimo gutera imbere
Nyobora serivisi yanjye bwite yo kwakira seriveri
Ibibazo ku bijyanye na serivisi zanjye cyangwa ikoranabuhanga birakaze: ndamutsa gusa kuri Discord
can_write: Ibyo nshobora kwandika (harimo na kode itunganyije nabi)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: seriveri uhereye ku yeni 30 ku kwezi
anw_p:
Serivisi yo kwakira seriveri ku bashaka gukoresha seriveri ariko badashobora gutanga amafaranga menshi.
Tangira buhoro, **uhereye ku yeni 30 gusa ku kwezi**.
sab_t: SABALISU: urutonde rwa seriveri za Minecraft
sab_p:
Shyira seriveri yawe ya Minecraft ku rutonde kandi ubone abantu bayikiniraho.
Ifasha abakinnyi bashaka seriveri ndetse na ba nyirazo bashaka kuyimenyekanisha.
storia_t: Storia: porogaramu ya seriveri ku seriveri nini za Minecraft
storia_p: Fork y'isoko ifunguye ya Folia ya Minecraft 26.2. Na **Storia Cluster**, isi imwe ishobora gukorera kuri seriveri nyinshi icyarimwe, kandi abakinnyi bimuka hagati yazo nta shusho yo gupakira.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: isi imwe isangiwe na seriveri nyinshi, ifite imiyoboro ihishe hagati yazo
**Relay y'inyongera**: relay ya kabiri ibika kopi nzima kandi isimbura iya mbere iyo ibuze
**Imiterere ya Linear**: isi ifata hafi kimwe cya kabiri cy'umwanya kuri disiki
**Isi muri RAM**, **Tick Guard**, API ya plugin ku makuru asangiwe, n'ibindi
